repin_authorizations.justification: Authorizes PR #436 to replace the weakening detector with the version that adds trusted base authorization for protected-artifact repins, rename-independent and extension-independent protected scope, and the namespace-capture controls.

Authorizes PR #436 to declare the two compositional verifiers and the repin-authorization regression module as runtime inputs of bootstrap.manifest, which became real reads once those files were content-pinned.
